blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Regulates major stock exchanges including NSE and BSE, along with mutual funds and collective investment schemes.
Mandated to register key market intermediaries such as brokers, merchant bankers, portfolio managers, and credit rating agencies.
Strictly prohibits insider trading and active prevention of fraudulent and unfair trade practices.
Promotes investor awareness and education while overseeing company takeovers and large capital issues.

blocks.content: • Registers brokers, merchant bankers, portfolio managers, and credit rating agencies.
Prevents fraudulent and unfair trade practices.
• Regulates mutual funds and collective investment schemes.
• Prevents fraudulent and unfair trade practices.

items: Registration of Credit Rating Agencies and Portfolio Managers is a mandatory function under SEBI, not RBI.
Prohibition of insider trading and regulation of company takeovers are direct statutory powers of SEBI.
SEBI oversees both capital market exchanges (NSE, BSE) and collective investment schemes/mutual funds.
